entries.name: T1.25 Sparse U-state 6-state sensitivity
entries.decision_rule: For each collapse variant, ARI(locked 9-state GMM labels, 6-state k=7 GMM labels) >= 0.9 indicates the sparse unemployment states do not drive the regime structure under that substantive collapse. If both variants have ARI >= 0.9, paper prose may state the regime structure is robust to collapsing U states. If either variant is below 0.9, disclose variant-specific sensitivity and do not claim U-state sparsity is harmless.

prose_direction.both_ge_0_9: Report sparse U states as not driving the locked 9-state regime structure; retain U states on substantive grounds because unemployment is conceptually distinct.
prose_direction.one_or_both_below_0_9: Report that at least one substantive collapse changes regime structure; disclose the variant(s) and avoid a robustness claim.

key_params.embedding: 6-state unigram + bigram frequencies (42 raw dims), standardised, PCA-20
